original_test_intent: Add exactly one approved SEL record and prove its exact stored content and bounded side effects while preserving prior history.
original_method: Use in-band Storage 0x0a/0x44 with a target-approved complete record vector, then read back the returned record ID.
manual_activity: Owner approves target, exact bytes, expected record/alerts and retention plan immediately before the single write, then owns any cleanup decision.
safety_requirements: Stop on mismatch or unexpected alert
No automatic retry or automatic erase
engineer_actions: Approve event vector and maintenance window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe: sensor type alone does not authorize the fixed record vector, the SSH wrapper is insecure and the result lacks returned-ID-specific validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a versioned allowlisted 0x0a/0x44 package only after exact-byte confirmation, with capacity checks and specific returned-ID readback.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All source bytes, placeholder, script and timing are retained; the Review layer does not silently replace them.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve SEL baseline, validate capacity and every record field, obtain fresh approval, add one record, read back its returned ID, compare exact semantics and record alert/retention outcomes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Rejects generic clearing, guessed sensor-only input and transport-only PASS while preserving the write objective.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only SEL inspection cannot substitute for Add SEL Entry; successful write does not cover Partial Add, Delete or Clear.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The entry may persist and trigger alerts or automation; rollback may require an explicit retention decision rather than safe deletion.

project_override_considerations: Another approved API may provide equivalent add/readback coverage only with exact field mapping and side-effect evidence; raw ipmitool tool coverage remains unverified if skipped.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clears the evidence it needs, leaves Sensor Type open while hard-coding the rest of the record, and accepts transport success. DeepSeek preserves those weaknesses and does not correlate the returned record ID.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Add SEL semantics are clear; exact project vector and approval are execution-readiness inputs, so the case is not permanently blocked but cannot run autonomously.

review_improvement: Makes the persistent log mutation exact, allowlisted, capacity-aware and verifiable without reducing functional coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Adding an SEL record is automatable after packaging, but it permanently changes fault history and can trigger consumers. Exact-byte human confirmation and returned-ID correlation are therefore mandatory.
